label: closed-book
what: bits of configuration memory that followed the memories of the probe design s2b through the states all one, all zero, written to every site at once; and, for each memory whose loaded word was found in the frames read before anything was written, where it lies and which memory of which site it is by the design's record of what it loaded where (docs/s2_plan.md, section 45, part 1). A place is an address the device named, a word of the frame read there (0 the first), and a bit of that word (0 the least significant). Which cell of its memory a place is, is said here only by the six moves of S2.3, which the search assumed; part 2 tests it.
outcome: 2: as many bits follow as the design has cells, each memory's word is found once and its 64 places are the candidates; 8 memories are not where the prediction said under its best form
